title: Oregon Youth Corps and Summer Conservation Corps
sponsor: Oregon Higher Education Coordinating Commission (Oregon Youth Works)
who_text: Oregon young people, typically ages 13 to 24
description: The state funds local youth corps across Oregon that give young people paid work experience, including the Summer Conservation Corps, its largest program. You apply through a local program near you listed on the state's Oregon Youth Works page.

title: OSU Extension Service Internship Program
pay_text: On average $15 per hour, 40 hours per week in summer
who_text: College and community college students, plus high school juniors and seniors
description: Paid summer internships at OSU Extension offices in Oregon counties, from mid-June to the end of August. Openings are usually announced in mid-February and you apply on the OSU Jobs website, ranking the counties you want.
